lang.description: The BCP 47 tag of this translation, used as the page's lang attribute.

extDescription.message: Look better on every video call. Blur or swap your background, fix lighting, mirror and zoom. Works on Meet, Discord, Zoom & more.
extDescription.description: The store summary and the extension's description. 132 characters at most.

cmdTogglePanel.message: Show or hide the in-call panel
cmdTogglePanel.description: Keyboard shortcut description, shown in the browser's shortcuts page.

openWindowTitle.description: Tooltip on the button that moves the popup into its own window.

powerLabel.description: Screen reader label for the main on/off switch.

previewStart.description: Button that starts the live camera preview in the popup.

previewStopTitle.description: Tooltip on the button that stops the preview.

mirror.description: Mirror the camera left to right.

flipShort.description: Short label for flip vertical, in the small in-call panel.

rotate.description: Rotate the camera in 90 degree steps.

sectionLook.description: Section heading for colour presets and sliders.

lookBw.description: Look preset: black and white. Keep it very short.

blur.description: Slider that blurs the whole picture.

beautify.description: Slider that softens skin while keeping eyes and hair sharp.

hue.description: Slider that shifts every colour around the colour wheel.

lowLight.description: Switch that brightens a dim room.

bgOff.description: Background mode: none. Very short, it shares a row with four others.

bgColour.description: Background mode: a solid colour. Very short.

bgScene.description: Background mode: an image. Very short.

bgVideo.description: Background mode: a looping video. Very short.

cutoutMethod.description: Label: how the person is separated from the background.

keyerAi.description: Cut-out method: an AI model on the computer.

keyerChroma.description: Cut-out method: removing one backdrop colour.

keyerNoteAi.message: Highest quality, no green screen needed. A few strict sites, like Google Meet, block it.

keyerNoteChroma.message: Works on every site, Google Meet included. Best with a plain, single colour backdrop behind you.
keyerNoteChroma.description: Note under the green screen option.

bgBlurStrength.description: Slider for how blurred the background is.

colour.description: Label next to the background colour picker.

uploadImageTitle.description: Tooltip on the button that adds your own background image.

uploadVideoTitle.description: Tooltip on the button that adds your own background video.

edgeFeather.description: Slider that softens the outline of the cut-out.

keyColour.description: Green screen: the backdrop colour to remove.

keyStrength.description: Green screen: how much of that colour is removed.

keySoftness.description: Green screen: how soft the removed edge is.

sectionPresence.description: Section heading: freeze frame, be right back, snapshot.

freezeFrame.description: Switch that holds the current picture.

freezeShort.description: Short label for freeze frame, in the in-call panel.

beRightBack.description: Switch that shows a be right back card instead of the camera.

brbShort.description: Short label for be right back, in the in-call panel.

brbDefault.description: The words drawn on the be right back card by default. Everyone on the call sees them.

brbImage.message: Set a be right back image…
brbImage.description: Button: choose an image for the be right back card.

snapshot.description: Row label: save the current frame.

snapShort.description: Short label for snapshot, in the in-call panel.

savePng.description: Button that saves the snapshot as a PNG file.

sectionOverlays.description: Section heading: name tag, logo, clock drawn into the video.

nameTag.description: Overlay: your name on the video.

nameShort.description: Short label for name tag, in the in-call panel.

yourName.description: Placeholder in the name tag text field.

logo.description: Overlay: your logo on the video.

logoShort.description: Short label for logo, in the in-call panel.

liveClock.description: Overlay: the current time on the video.

clockShort.description: Short label for live clock, in the in-call panel.

positionOf.description: Screen reader label for a group of four corner buttons.

positionAt.description: Screen reader label for one corner button.

resetAll.description: Button in the in-call panel: put every setting back.

panelHideTitle.description: Tooltip on the in-call panel's close button.

powerOn.description: State of the in-call panel's power button. Very short.

powerOff.description: State of the in-call panel's power button. Very short.

panelMidCall.description: Label before the keyboard shortcut that opens the in-call panel.

shortcutNotSet.description: Shown when no keyboard shortcut is set.

shortcutNotSetTitle.message: No shortcut is set. Click to choose one.
shortcutNotSetTitle.description: Tooltip when no keyboard shortcut is set.

getHelpTitle.message: Ask a question or report a problem

builtBy.description: Followed by the author's name, as a link.

resizeTitle.description: Tooltip on the popup's resize handles.

flashSaved.description: Shown briefly after a snapshot is saved.

flashFailed.description: Shown briefly when a snapshot fails.

flashNoCamera.description: Shown briefly when there is no camera to snapshot.

previewFailed.description: The browser's own error message follows.

statusIdle.message: The AI model starts when a camera is on.

statusError.message: This site blocks the AI model. Switch the cut-out method to Green screen, which works here.

grantTitle.description: Title of the tab that asks for camera permission.

grantBody1.message: Cam360 needs permission once to show your live preview. Your browser cannot ask from inside the small popup, so it asks here instead.

grantBody2.message: When your browser asks, next to the address bar, choose Allow.
grantBody2.description: Paragraph. Use the browser's own word for Allow.

grantBody2Firefox.message: When Firefox asks, keep Remember for all cameras ticked, then choose Allow. Otherwise Firefox asks again every time.
grantBody2Firefox.description: Firefox only, in place of grantBody2. Name the box as Firefox labels it in this language if you know it, else describe it.

grantOk.message: Camera access granted. You can close this tab and open Cam360 again.

grantDeclined.message: Camera access was declined or is blocked.

grantBlockedChrome.message: If no prompt appeared, the camera may already be blocked for this extension. Click the camera icon at the right end of the address bar, or open $PAGE$ and remove Cam360 from the blocked list. Then try again.
grantBlockedChrome.description: Chrome, Edge, Brave, Arc. $PAGE$ is a settings address, shown as code.

grantBlockedFirefox.message: If no prompt appeared, the camera may already be blocked for this extension. Open $PAGE$, find Camera under Permissions, and remove the block on Cam360. Then try again.
grantBlockedFirefox.description: Firefox. $PAGE$ is a settings address, shown as code. Use the names Firefox shows in this language.

grantNoCamera.message: No usable camera was found, or another app is using it.

grantNoCameraHint.message: Close other apps that might be holding the camera, then try again.

grantFailed.description: The browser's own error message follows.
